subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, then select the option "No error".**

It's 4 p.m. local time and quite a/ large crowd has gathered from yesterday/evening around the giant stage.

options.text: large crowd has gathered from yesterday
It's 4 p.m. local time and quite a

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Large crowd has gathered from yesterday'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The segment **"large crowd has gathered from yesterday"** contains a grammatical error.
 
• The word **"from" **should be **replaced with "since"** to indicate the duration of time.
 
• **"Since"** is more appropriate in this context as it signifies that the crowd has been gathering continuously starting from the previous day.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'It's 4 p.m. local time and quite a large crowd has gathered **since **yesterday evening around the giant stage.*
